prompt: Produce an implementation plan—not code—for migrating an existing service from session cookies signed by one shared secret to key-id-based rotating signing keys with no forced logout. The plan must identify current-state evidence to inspect, compatibility phases, data/config changes, rollout/rollback gates, observability, failure modes, security review points, owner/order dependencies, and exact verification before each irreversible step. Keep unresolved implementation choices explicit rather than pretending the repository was inspected when it was not.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual planning boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (children=architecture-planning,business-case-analysis,migration-planning,product-management,project-program-management,release-planning,startup-operations; near-neighbor=plan-mode), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Translate the task contract into coherent dependency-ordered work with explicit acceptance criteria, risks, and verification.
The plan separates known evidence, assumptions, and decisions, and every rollout phase has prerequisites plus observable success/rollback criteria before advancing.
The result must not treat a happy path, generated artifact, compilation, or unsupported assumption as sufficient proof of planning correctness.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Acceptance criteria; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
